item.title: How The 1972 Film SILENT RUNNING Helped Shape the Gritty Galaxy of STAR WARS
item.description: A new video essay is shining a spotlight on how the movie Silent Running helped lay the groundwork for the lived-in sci-fi aesthetic that would later define Star Wars. Film essayist Gabe of Golden Flicker takes a deep dive into the 1972 cult classic directed by Douglas Trumbull, exploring how its gritty, industrial realism and handmade effects quietly influenced the look and feel of George Lucas’ galaxy far, far away.
